title: gatewatch: constitution standard is missing
description: Evidence: repository HEAD 5547ad74632fd2aae1ab4f649e86a9a197b4cbdc; docs/CONSTITUTION.md is absent (and CLAUDE.md is also absent). title: gatewatch: triggers mandate changed without seed sign-off
description: Evidence: SHA 5547ad74632fd2aae1ab4f649e86a9a197b4cbdc changed .warren/triggers.yaml (added the gatewatch, ratchetwatch, tastewatch, and other audit scheduling entries). Article IX requires any merged change touching the audit entries in .warren/triggers.yaml to have explicit human sign-off recorded in the seed tracker. No seed issues exist in .seeds/issues.jsonl, so no explicit sign-off is present. This is a mandate-protection finding.
